Subject: Q3 Security Audit Follow-Up

Hi team,

The external security audit for Q3 wrapped up last Friday. The auditors flagged two medium-severity issues in the access-review process and one low-severity finding about password rotation. Please review the attached summary and note that the remediation deadline is October 15. No further action is needed from the auditors at this time; they'll schedule a re-test in November. Thanks to everyone who provided evidence and logs during the review.

Subject: Draft Budget Forecast for Q4

Hi all,

Attached is the draft budget forecast for Q4. Please review the revenue projections and the proposed cuts to discretionary spending. We need your feedback by Wednesday so we can finalize the numbers before the board meeting. The finance team has done a thorough job, and the forecast looks conservative but realistic. Let me know if you have any questions.

Subject: Your 2024 Performance Review

Hi Jordan,

I wanted to share some thoughts ahead of our performance review meeting next week. Overall, your work this year has been strong, particularly on the client onboarding project. You consistently met deadlines and collaborated well with the team. I noted a few areas for growth, such as taking more initiative in cross-team meetings and improving documentation. The automated feedback tool flagged no major concerns, which aligns with my assessment. We'll discuss goals for next year during our meeting. Please come prepared with your own reflections.

Best,
Alex
